Metadata.title: Natural Land CR — Nature tours in Costa Rica
Metadata.description: Locally guided tours to Costa Rica's volcanoes, cloud forests, rivers and beaches. Small groups and responsible travel.

Home.heroSubtitle: Tours led by people who grew up among volcanoes, rivers and cloud forest.
Home.intro: We are Costa Rican guides. We take small groups to the places we have known since childhood, with respect for the land and the communities that protect it.

local.title: Local guides
local.text: Real knowledge of the terrain, wildlife and culture of every region.

small.title: Small groups
small.text: Fewer people, more silence, better chances to spot wildlife.

responsible.title: Responsible travel
responsible.text: Low-impact routes and partnerships with conservation projects.

Home.ctaText: Send us a direct message and we'll share prices, available dates and every detail.

Tours.title: Tours
Tours.description: All our experiences in Costa Rica: volcanoes, waterfalls, cloud forest, rivers and beaches.
Tours.empty: We'll publish our tours soon. Message us in the meantime.
Tours.askPriceText: Prices vary by date and group size. Send us a direct message and we'll reply quickly.
